summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) containing Exhibit 99.1, a routine monthly operating statistics release signed by CFO Ricardo Bottas. For September 2026, LATAM transported 7.6 million passengers, up 3.7% year over year, with consolidated capacity (ASK) up 7.7%, traffic (RPK) up 6.2%, load factor down 1.2 points to 83.1%, and cargo tons up 4.7% to 85 thousand. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; no special-situation angle exists.
